about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am Neda Khanifar, and I have built my professional experience in business development, international trade, market development and the building of commercial relationships. My work focuses on identifying business opportunities, understanding market needs, acquiring customers, negotiating, and following the different stages of commercial partnerships through.

Throughout my career I have worked in market research, identifying potential customers, direct marketing, product presentation and developing relationships with corporate clients. I also have experience negotiating with domestic and international customers, following up on commercial agreements, and coordinating between the various parties to move orders forward.

In trade and export, I have experience following operational processes from order registration and the preparation of commercial documents to transport coordination, customs follow-up and liaison with companies working in logistics. This experience has given me a practical view of how market development, sales and the fulfilment of commercial commitments relate to one another.

My approach to business rests on understanding the market, effective communication, professional negotiation, accountability and consistent follow-up. I believe the real value of a business opportunity becomes clear when it can be brought to a result through planning, effective collaboration and precise execution.

Today my focus is on developing lasting trade partnerships, identifying new opportunities in regional and international markets, and taking part in projects where I can apply my experience and abilities in business development, trade and operational coordination.

items.title: Organiser and speaker, B2B seminar
items.text: Organised and spoke at a B2B trade seminar attended by more than 100 economic and business players; the Khuzestan Chamber of Commerce was a guest at the seminar.

items.title: Selected among Khuzestan's distinguished young people
items.text: In 2023, Neda Khanifar's name appeared in an IRNA report on the selection of the country's top young figures from Khuzestan province. She was also honoured, within the activities of Junior Chamber International (JCI), as one of the distinguished young people.

items.title: Best booth, Ahvaz Agricultural Exhibition
items.text: Responsible for organising and managing the booth, presenting products and communicating directly with customers and economic players; at the end of the exhibition the booth won the title of best booth.
